summary: When a Claude, Codex or OpenCode sign-in is still not finished after setup's handover, the closing line no longer says 'pick a theme' and, for an instance, no longer sends the person to a plain claude, codex login or opencode auth login in their own terminal (which would sign in their default account, not the instance's): it names fractal --instance NAME setup to try the sign-in again. Without an instance the line still names the harness's own command in the person's terminal.

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: Only the text setup prints changes; no client, protocol or wire change.

downtime.detail: No restart is needed beyond the usual daemon upgrade.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; it only changes printed words.
